summary.business: Vivid Electromech Limited designs, fabricates, assembles, tests, and commissions LV and MV electrical panels and automation systems. The company operates two integrated manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra and maintains OEM partnerships with ABB, LK, and Schneider Electric.

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management)
- ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management)
- ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety)
- Type-tested per IEC 61439-1 & 2, IEC 61641, IEC 62271-200
- ZED Bronze Certification (Zero Effect, Zero Defect)
- SMERA rating of SE2B (High performance and financial strength)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward-integrated, in-house manufacturing across the full production process at fully integrated units (over 34,000 sq. ft.) covering design, engineering, sheet-metal fabrication (CNC turret punching/bending), in-house copper and aluminium busbar fabrication for captive use, surface treatment and powder coating, assembly/wiring and testing. The Navi Mumbai unit performs complete fabrication and coating; prefabricated and coated components are transferred to the Pune unit for assembly. Primary raw materials (CRCA/GI sheets, aluminium/copper busbars, wires, paints) are sourced from domestic suppliers (no imports); switchgear components are procured from OEMs, primarily ABB India Limited under a limited price-locking arrangement. No forward integration into distribution is disclosed; sales are direct via an in-house sales & marketing team and the GeM portal.

customers.title: Oem (RHP)
customers.body:
- ABB India Limited (ArTu K low-voltage switchboards licence, MV Panel Builder Certificate)
- Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation (LK)
- Schneider Electric (accreditation for use of LV switchgear components)
- Larsen & Toubro (L&T) Enersys LV electrical Panels (authorised partner)

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue mix shift towards higher-value data centre projects (35.80% of FY25 revenue vs 5.38% in FY24)
- Operating leverage from integrated manufacturing and capacity utilisation
- Raw material cost management (materials consumed at 68.63% of revenue in FY25, down from 76.64% in FY23)
- Geographic diversification to reduce dependence on Maharashtra (85.94% of FY25 domestic revenue)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Setting up a new integrated manufacturing unit at Ambernath, Thane to expand capacity and modernise processes
- Expanding geographical footprint across Indian states in a phased manner to reduce regional concentration risk
- Strengthening marketing network and customer base through targeted marketing initiatives
- Maintaining long-standing relationships with suppliers and customers to support supply chain stability and repeat business

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The company is setting up a new integrated manufacturing facility at Village Nahren, Taluka Ambernath, District Thane, Maharashtra, measuring 7,977 sq. mtrs. The facility will manufacture LV and MV electrical panels and automation systems and will be equipped with advanced fabrication and coating equipment including a PSBB line from PRIMA Power (Finland), 3D CNC busbar machines, and an automatic powder coating plant. The project aims to support manufacturing operations and improve production capacity and processes.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Integrated in-house manufacturing (design to testing) across two facilities reducing third-party dependence
- Diverse product portfolio spanning LV and MV panels up to 36 kV for multiple end-markets
- Strategic OEM partnerships with ABB, L&T, LK, and Schneider Electric enabling type-tested, branded panel manufacturing
- Established presence in the high-growth data centre segment (35.80% of FY25 revenue)
- Experienced promoter leadership with over 25 years in the electrical panel industry

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Raw material price volatility and supplier concentration — Primary raw materials (CRCA sheets, GI sheets, aluminium/copper bus bars, switchgears) are subject to commodity price fluctuations. Switchgears are primarily procured from ABB India Limited with limited-duration price locking arrangements. Material costs accounted for 77.94% of total cost in FY25.
- High geographic concentration in Maharashtra — 85.94% of domestic revenue in FY25 came from Maharashtra. Any regional economic downturn or policy change could materially impact revenue.
- Customer and sector concentration risk — Data centre segment contributed 35.80% of FY25 revenue, a sharp increase from 5.38% in FY24. A slowdown in data centre capex could adversely affect growth and profitability.
- Dependence on OEM partnerships for product certification and market access — The company's ability to manufacture type-tested, branded panels depends on continued OEM licences from ABB, L&T, LK, and Schneider Electric. Termination or non-renewal could impact competitive positioning.
- Working capital intensity — The business requires significant working capital for inventory and receivables; Rs. 4,000 lakhs of IPO proceeds are allocated to meet working capital requirements.
- Execution risk on new manufacturing unit — The proposed Ambernath facility involves a total estimated project cost of Rs. 6,673.56 lakhs. Delays in commissioning, cost overruns, or slower-than-expected ramp-up could impact returns on invested capital.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up a new integrated manufacturing unit at Village Nahren, Ambernath, Thane for LV and MV electrical panels and automation systems.**
- **Repay certain borrowings availed by the Company from IPO proceeds.**
- **Meet working capital requirements of the Company from IPO proceeds.**
- **Expand operations gradually to other regions in India in a phased manner to reduce geographic concentration.**
- **Strengthen marketing network and expand customer base through marketing initiatives.**
- **Continue investing in capacity expansion and modernisation of equipment and facilities to support production operations.**
- **Current combined installed capacity of 7,500 units per annum across Navi Mumbai and Pune facilities.**
